newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar Diamond sees Q2 margins improving.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar Diamond sees Q2 margins improving.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said in a statement with earnings that the second quarter of 1997 had started well, after reporting a rise in first quarter per share net income to $0.35 from a proforma $0.28 a year ago.
"The second quarter appears to be off to a good start with refining and retail gasoline margins improving," chief executive Roger Hemminghaus said.
Net income in the first quarter rose to $27.6 million from a proforma $22.0 million and cash flow from operations rose to $87.9 million, $1.18 per share, from $71.6 million, $0.96.
